description: Draft concise repository-wide Copilot instructions from verified project facts.

Inspect the attached repository and draft `.github/copilot-instructions.md` for
its contributors. First identify stable project facts, the audience and tasks the
instructions should support, and relevant existing guidance. Use evidence from
the repository; do not invent policies or repeat entire documents.

Keep the draft concise and actionable. Clarify how it relates to `AGENTS.md`,
path-specific instruction files, prompts, and skills. Include only guidance that
should apply broadly, and point to detailed sources rather than duplicating them.
Respect the repository's security and data boundaries.

Return the proposed file content, a brief evidence map, assumptions or questions
for the team, and a checklist to verify the instructions are loaded in the
intended Copilot client. Do not edit files until a human approves the draft.
